# `openinference.llm` span

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

A call to a large language model, such as a chat completion or a text completion request. It captures the request sent to the provider and the response that came back.

`openinference.span.kind` MUST be `LLM`.

A completions (non-chat) API call records `llm.prompts` and `llm.choices`
in place of `llm.input_messages` and `llm.output_messages`.

See [LLM Spans](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/blob/main/spec/spans/llm.md).

**Span name** is not constrained. It SHOULD identify the operation, e.g. `ChatCompletion`.

**Span kind:** OpenInference does not constrain the OpenTelemetry `SpanKind`. The OpenInference kind is the value of `openinference.span.kind`.

**Requirement level:** `Recommended`

**[1] `openinference.span.kind`:** Required on every OpenInference span. It is distinct from OpenTelemetry's own `SpanKind`.
See [Span Kinds](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/blob/main/spec/general/span-kinds.md).

**[2] `input.documents`:** When the operation takes file documents as input outside of a message.

**[3] `input.images`:** When the operation takes images as input outside of a message.

**[4] `llm.request.model_name`:** When the requested model can differ from the model that served the response.

**[5] `llm.response.model_name`:** When the requested model can differ from the model that served the response.

**[6] `output.documents`:** When the operation produces file documents outside of a message.

**[7] `output.images`:** When the operation produces images outside of a message.
